title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a-Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Kraft Foods Global, Inc., Atlantic Gelatin Division.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul G. Afonso, and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 06-GC-6)
